title: enigami
purpose: An adversarial probe harness for investigating intelligence, wisdom, creativity and imagination in a Claude model, where 'the capacity is absent' is a result the design can actually produce.
nextStep: STATE AS OF 2026-08-23. Harness complete, 24 tests, live path working. One probe has run for real: imagination.counterfactual_world scored 100% counterfactual / 83% control, the pre-registered rule said `supports`, and the anonymised adversarial reviewer refuted it at survival probability 0.22 — correctly. Its Fisher exact claim (p=0.478 for 12/12 vs 10/12) was verified independently, and the control arm sat one item from the falsifier. That probe's result should not be believed; the redesign is EN-10. EN-12 generalises the lesson: falsifier thresholds across all four probes were set without regard to what their sample sizes can resolve. Next: run the remaining three probes (`uv run enigami run intelligence wisdom creativity`, ~$1), then do EN-12 before trusting any verdict. Read project/ARCHITECTURE.md section 2 first.

repo.remote: STATUS: UNKNOWN – REQUIRES CONFIRMATION (no GitHub remote created yet)

deployment.target: local CLI only — no server, no systemd unit, no container, no store artifact

probes.intelligence: intelligence.calibration — does stated confidence discriminate right from wrong
probes.wisdom: wisdom.reframing_invariance — stability under irrelevant reframing, movement under a relevant fact
probes.creativity: creativity.mode_collapse — distinct ideas across ten independent samples
probes.imagination: imagination.counterfactual_world — holding an invented world across three inferential steps

decisions.decision: Pre-registration enforced in the Prereg constructor, not by convention
decisions.reason: A hypothesis that can be rewritten after seeing the result is not a hypothesis; a 40-character floor per field makes a placeholder fail to load

decisions.decision: manifest.json is fsynced before the first API call and mtime-checked by `enigami verify`
decisions.reason: Makes the pre-registration ordering auditable at the filesystem level rather than trusted

decisions.decision: Every probe must declare a null model that would score well without the capacity
decisions.reason: Forced discrimination over calibration error in intelligence.calibration, and the ordinary-rule control arm in imagination.counterfactual_world

decisions.decision: The refuter sees the subject as 'System S', with model and vendor names scrubbed
decisions.reason: A reviewer that knows it is grading its own family has an obvious reason to be generous

decisions.decision: Judge is the same model as the subject
decisions.reason: A weaker judge cannot detect a stronger subject's failures, which biases every judged probe toward 'supports' — the worse error. Cost recorded as a caveat on every judged finding; open as EN-7

decisions.decision: Structured output via raw output_config rather than the messages.parse helper
decisions.reason: effort and format share output_config, and judges must be pinned to high effort

decisions.decision: Offline stub responder, with report.write_finding refusing offline runs
decisions.reason: The pipeline must be verifiable with no key, and schema-valid nonsense must never be able to reach findings/

rejected.option: Varying temperature to study output diversity
rejected.reason: temperature/top_p/top_k were removed from the current Claude model family and return 400; independent resampling is used instead, and Subject.ask raises on these parameters

rejected.option: Scoring creative output for quality with a judge
rejected.reason: A fluent system clears any quality bar a judge sets, and the judge rewards fluency; diversity across independent samples is harder to fake

rejected.option: Benchmark-style hard questions as the intelligence probe
rejected.reason: Likely contaminated by training data; knowing when you are wrong is harder to fake than knowing the answer

rejected.option: Stock counterfactuals such as 'what if ice sank'
rejected.reason: Stock counterfactuals have stock answers in the training data; both worlds are invented for this repo
Runs are directories; the volume does not justify it

sensitivity: credentials — one Anthropic API key in a gitignored .env at mode 600, written only by deploy/scripts/setup-anthropic-env.sh. transcripts/ is gitignored and holds model outputs, never the key. No personal data.

firstLiveRun.note: Finding refuted by adversarial review; see EN-10. Do not cite this result.
